description.value:
Hierro ("iron skin"). Your compressed reiryoku hardens your skin. You gain resistance to physical damage equal to half your level (minimum 1).

Sonido ("sound"). You gain a +5-foot status bonus to all your Speeds. At 11th level this increases to +10 feet.

Hierro is broader than Thermal Nimbus — all physical rather than one energy type — at half the rate, and it arrives at 1st level on a class with light armour and 10 Hit Points.

Automation note: Sonido is written as a status bonus in the class guide. A status bonus on the Speed selector is listed in Foundry's breakdown but contributes nothing to the total, while an untyped one on the same selector applies — so it is authored untyped and the five feet actually reach the table.
